```python
  FROM Player

  GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
)

ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
```

```python
""")
```

```python
db.execute("""

       1.0 * t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr AS rate

JOIN satscores AS t
  ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY rate ASC, s.CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 5;
""")
```
